title: Darién: The Swamp That Cost Scotland Its Independence
summary: Tells the story of how, in sixteen ninety-eight, Scotland staked much of its national wealth on a single gamble by attempting to found a trading colony named Caledonia on Panama's Darién coast, and how that venture collapsed within two years under disease, starvation, an English embargo, and a Spanish siege. The episode examines how the sunken money brought Scotland to the table for union with England in seventeen oh seven.
